\par\vspace{3pt}
{\footnotesize\raggedright SARIMAX keeps the frozen SARIMA orders and options, a single fit on the training data and one-step updates without re-estimation. Exogenous variables enter lagged as in the tabular models ($x_{T-2}$, $x_{T-4}$, $x_{T-7}$). SARIMAX-PC (main specification, fixed before seeing results): first principal component of climate and of emergencies, PCA fitted on training data only. SARIMAX-30: the 30 exogenous variables, over-parameterised (41--89 training months). Diff. vs. SARIMA: paired 95\% bootstrap CI; DM: Diebold--Mariano with HLN correction, absolute loss, $h = 1$. Converged fits (windows): SARIMAX-PC sutil: 5/5; SARIMAX-30 sutil: 4/5; SARIMAX-PC dulce: 5/5; SARIMAX-30 dulce: 5/5. MAE in tonnes; 95\% CI: paired bootstrap of months within each test window (B = 10,000, seed 42). All results in this table are post-protocol analyses (second review round) and do not modify the pre-registered ten-model ranking.\par}
